files.prompt: Create a polished original game environment concept approval sheet for RAIL ARENA, titled 'FOUNDRY SKY GARDENS — AERIAL CONCEPT'. High quality detailed AAA environment concept, landscape 3:2 canvas. One dominant elevated three-quarter aerial view of a compact floating competitive arena above an immense bright billowing white cloud sea, with a small inset clear top-down layout at bottom right. The gameplay footprint is a rectangular 56 by 40 metre lower outer circulation loop, an east-west Crown bridge at 4m height crossing its centre, a north-south underpass at ground level under this bridge, four side wing balconies at 2m height, four wide ramps connecting the outer lower sides to the wings and bridge. Open voids remain between bridge/ramp/loop structures. Preserve clear broad walkways, architectural cover, protected spawn pockets, two opposed blue/red live-view portal gates on the north/south ends. In addition, prominently feature ONE separate central circular floating summit platform, diameter roughly 14m, at 22m above the lower arena, suspended clearly above the Crown, with a minimal broken classical stone ring canopy and a few low opaque cover blocks. Exactly FOUR gold/cyan jump pad launch devices, one in each lower quadrant, have four thin elegant gold dotted trajectory arcs to four separate landing sectors on this ONE high summit platform. All four arcs must be unambiguously visible and label the summit 'SUMMIT +22m'. Do not connect summit with stairs or bridges. Label the base 'CROWN +4m', a wing 'WINGS +2m', and mark '4 SUMMIT LAUNCH PADS' in a small clean legend. Architectural theme inspired by the emotional atmosphere of Final Fantasy XI Sky / Ru'Aun Gardens: luminous ancient floating garden sanctuary, weathered warm ivory limestone and marble, turquoise inset energy channels, aged bronze details, sculpted pale stone retaining walls and tall ancient arches, lush emerald grass beds and shrubs in bounded planters, elegant wind-shaped trees at perimeter accents, hanging vines underneath edges. Use original architecture, do not reproduce FFXI assets or its exact map. Four thin graceful waterfalls spill from outer garden corners far below into mist, with soft pale aquamarine water. Surrounding distant floating garden ruins establish scale. Foliage sits outside playable circulation and behind cover, no tall grass or trees obscuring sightlines. Readable competitive FPS environment, believable human scale with two tiny neutral human silhouettes. Blue sunny sky, warm directional sunlight, cool soft shadows, refined realistic stone textures and restrained moss at joints, grounded buildable geometry, no clutter, no giant wilderness, no guns or HUD. Typography minimal and clean. A designed architectural concept rendering rather than a real game screenshot. Do not show the previous two separate Twin Platforms. At bottom include small text 'CONCEPT FOR APPROVAL — NOT AN IN-GAME CAPTURE'.

Create a landscape 3:2 professional original environment concept approval sheet for RAIL ARENA titled 'FOUNDRY SKY GARDENS — PLAYER EXPERIENCE'. Matching palette of warm ivory weathered limestone, pale marble paving, aged bronze, subtle turquoise channels, emerald foliage, blue sky and bright cloud sea. Architectural atmosphere inspired by Final Fantasy XI Sky / Ru'Aun Gardens but original building forms, not copied assets. Layout is Foundry v2, a compact rectangular 56x40m floating FPS arena, lower loop and central underpass at 0m, four side wing balconies at +2m reached by wide ramps, Crown bridge spanning east-west at +4m. One separate circular summit platform floats high at +22m directly above centre, accessible by four launch pads in the four lower quadrants. Clear buildable routes and competitive visibility.
COMPOSITION: exactly THREE carefully composed rendered-concept panels, thin borders, one large eye-level main panel taking left two-thirds and two stacked smaller panels right. Main panel label '01 / LOWER GARDEN → CROWN': camera at 1.65m standing on a lower outer-loop stone path, looking obliquely along the Crown bridge and ramp turnout; real human scale, path widths 4-6m, broad stone steps NOT on playable ramp; smooth ramps are traversal paths. Full-height opaque stone cover screens and low carved parapet cover with bronze trims. Medical glowing mint pickup in a clear alcove. Bounded planted beds with grass, shrubs, a few flowering plants and an elegant tree behind retaining cover. Hanging vines on external faces, distant pale ruin-islands, a corner waterfall disappearing into luminous clouds. The bright cloud sea and floating height are visible through deliberate voids and under the bridge. In the sky above, show the separate elevated summit platform smaller, with clear vertical separation.
Upper-right panel label '02 / SUMMIT +22m': eye-level from the high circular floating summit, showing its textured pale stone floor, minimal broken classical column-ring canopy, low cover, four distinct reserved turquoise/gold landing quadrants, and wide open marked gaps between protective parapets that let players deliberately drop back toward lower arena. No impenetrable continuous railing trapping players. The lower Foundry arena visible far below at one side, with faint four rising gold launch trails. Very little foliage on summit so sightlines stay readable.
Lower-right panel label '03 / GARDEN EDGE & WATERFALL': close material/environment detail of a low stone planter, grass, small flowers, moss in stone seams, trailing ivy, bronze water lip spilling aquamarine water over the edge into clouds. Do not put obstructive foliage on paths. Caption strip 'IVORY STONE • TEAL ENERGY • LIVING GARDENS • CLOUD SEA'. Sunlit serene ancient sky sanctuary meets readable competitive arena, controlled foliage placement, realistic stone microtexture, sophisticated game-production art direction, calm light and no excessive bloom. No characters with guns, no HUD, no FFXI logos, no unrelated city or wilderness. Include small bottom text 'CONCEPT FOR APPROVAL — NOT AN IN-GAME CAPTURE'.
